provider_action_groups.note: Shared transport, with distinct create/update preconditions and permissions retained.

scope_review_note: Operations automatically associated with an explicit family but absent from its required list are supporting/optional candidates for that family, not additional required development units. Wildcard constituent review remains mandatory; this file does not declare unreviewed operations globally out of scope.
